Q: SVG circle appears briefly at (0,0) before animating to correct position — how to fix? A:
  • Hide the circle with visibility="hidden"
  • Show circle with <set attributeName="visibility" from="hidden" to="visible" begin="1s" />
  • change begin

<svg viewBox="0 0 30 30" style="background:pink;width:160px">
  <circle cx="15" cy="15" r="7" fill="green" visibility="hidden">
    <set attributeName="visibility" from="hidden" to="visible" begin="1s" />
    <animate attributeName="r" dur="1.5s" repeatCount="indefinite" 
             values="7;11;7" keyTimes="0;0.5;1"
             calcMode="spline" keySplines="0.4 0 0.6 1; 0.4 0 0.6 1" />
  </circle>
</svg>

Q: Best way to handle Package 'x' x.x.x has a known high severity vulnerability A:

@Guru Stron is right. Even the CentralPackageTransitivePinningEnabled naming is suggestive that you need Central Package Management (CPM) from its prefix, but the ManagePackageVersionsCentrally tag is not used, therefore TransitivePinning wouldn't work. Also makes sense that Transitive Pinning is a subsection in the CPM docs, because it's ultimately a CPM feature, hence why any article out there talks about CPM when talking about Transitive Pinning. And the fact that it did nothing without CPM, is also suggestive it's not supposed to.
